item.title: [Due in 2 days] Defender for Servers stops billing Windows 10/11 and other desktops as servers on 1 November and counts every machine separately, golden-image clones included
item.description:
Multi-session and VDI hosts protected today through Defender for Servers Plan 1 move to a Defender for Endpoint licensing route; a host that falls between the two is where coverage silently lapses.

Azure · deadline 2026-11-01 · Before 1 November list Plan 1 machines whose OS is a client SKU (including AVD multi-session) and confirm each has a Defender for Endpoint licence; check golden-image clones that share an Arc ID, because each now counts separately.

item.title: [Due in 2 days] Security Operator loses default access to email threat policies and the Tenant Allow/Block List under Defender Unified RBAC, from early November
item.description:
Adding a block entry to the Tenant Allow/Block List is a routine containment step in a phishing incident. An analyst who holds only Security Operator will find that step denied mid-incident some day in November, with no error that names this change.

Defender XDR · deadline 2026-11-01 · List who holds Entra Security Operator and uses it for email threat policies or the Tenant Allow/Block List; before November assign those people the Unified RBAC permissions Core security settings and Detection tuning, or a role that includes them, and test a block entry with a Security Operator-only account.
